title: Regional model sourcing priorities and token savings (roughwork)
summary: Working spreadsheet and narrative for prioritizing which model families and regional variants we should route to for Hosted API to maximize gross margin while preserving 99th-pct latency SLOs. Drafts cost assumptions, sensitivity slices, and a short actionable shortlist for sourcing/quantization experiments and routing fallbacks.
workbook_snapshot: This is a flattened export of the working tab used in the spreadsheet: columns = [region, model_family, variant (fp16/int8/4bit), est_token_cost_usd_per_1k, est_latency_ms_p50, est_latency_ms_p95, expected_accuracy_delta_pct, recommended_route_priority]. Rows include North America, EU, APAC and model families: Llama-3-70B, Red-Base-13B, Falcon-40B, open-gpt-6B. Example row: NA | Red-Base-13B | int8-q4 | 0.11 | 42 | 110 | -0.6 | 1 (preferred)
key_assumptions: 1) GPU spot mix and reserved pool blend cost per effective vGPU hour by region (NA cheaper by ~8% vs EU, APAC +12% prem). 2) Quantization reduces token compute cost by 30-55% depending on model size and kernel support. 3) Prefix caching reduces effective tokens for conversational flows by 18% median for PLG product tests. 4) Tail latency SLOs require fallback to smaller families when p95 > 400ms. 5) Pricing bucket for customers uses tiered per-token pricing (current list) — use mid-tier to compute margin.

sensitivity_analysis: Quick sensitivity slices run by varying: token price (±20%), quantization benefit (±10pp), cache hit rate (10% vs 25%) and reserved capacity utilization (70% vs 90%). Key takeaways: - Red-Base int8 remains the best cost/margin lever across regions unless accuracy requirements push >+1.0% quality delta. - Llama-3-70B is only margin-favorable for customers paying premium (>2x baseline token price) or on high-throughput narrow-answer workloads where p95 can be lowered by batching. - Cache hit improvements deliver linear margin gains; every +5 pp cache hit translates to ~3–4% uplift in gross margin on standard chat mix.
recommendations: 1) Shortlist: prioritize rolling Red-Base-13B int8 variants to EU and APAC pools with aggressive kernel tuning and validate accuracy on our eval prompt sets (deadline: 3 weeks). 2) Pilot: enable region-aware routing policy that prefers Red-Base int8 when customer SLA <500ms and accuracy tolerance <=1%; fall back to Llama-3-fp16 only for high-accuracy flagged requests. 3) Experiment: schedule quantization+kernel workstream for Falcon-40B to bring int8 parity (target cost reduction 35%) — sprint 2 focus. 4) Pricing: recommend a temporary regional token multiplier for APAC (+10%) in ratecard to maintain margin while we improve APAC reserved utilization. 5) Cache: invest in a quick win to add per-customer prefix cache TTL tuning; estimate 6% margin uplift for top 10 customers.
